comments.author: Sonia
comments.body: I am pretty sure there is prequest. You must find Guam before you can get this quest. And to find Guam you need to to the big chain starting with EL Paso.

comments.author: Junchul
comments.body: I have this discovery but I haven't followed the long chain after El Paso. I do have El Paso itself though.

comments.author: Enver
comments.body:
You can "find" Guam just by porting there...?

I popped the quest without having el paso, having discovered guam though.

comments.author: Junchul
comments.body: There's two different discoveries, Guam port (which you discover indeed by porting there) and Guam island (which requires a 4-quest chain starting with El Paso quest = Straights of Magellan discovery). I know, it's weird how the game treats geography discoveries. I had sailed in the amazon numerous times, discovering fish and animals/plants on the landings and fighting NPC pirates, but the game thought I hadn't discovered the river until a geography friend helped me do the relevant quest :-).

comments.author: Enver
comments.body:
Oh ok.

Still, I pulled this quest without having done the guam island, so I don't think there is any pre-req (except maybe some fame or stuff).

comments.author: Hawka
comments.body:
I pulled this quest with main, But for the alt, I couldn't pull it even after fleeting with my main character. I guess you should discover Guam first as port settlement.
Good luck :)
